findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 342 requests to 97 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 4.7 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 3.5 MB (74%) came from third-party domains, 1.7 MB of it from services classified as tracking (248 requests).

63 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), 33across.com (33Across, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising), adsafeprotected.com (Integral Ad Science, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising).
169 cookies were set by third-party domains (218 cookies in total).
